note: Unitree Go2 visual meshes, decimated. `name` is the mesh, not a robot link: the four legs share one hip (flipped by the <visual> rpy the URDF gives FR, RL and RR), a thigh and its mirror, a calf and its mirror, and one foot, so baking per link would put the same triangles in this file four times. Every <visual> origin in go2_description.urdf is the identity apart from those hip flips, so the vertices are the vendor's own, quantised to int16 multiples of `unit` metres and nothing else; `f` indexes them in threes. Colours are read out of the COLLADA effects, which is where Unitree put them.
